senses.gloss: --Killed Dundhu, the son of अरूरु, on the advice of Uttanka. वा. ६८. ३१.

(I)--the son of विश्रवस् (वैश्रावण) and इडविडा. His father initiated him into a great विद्या। Father of three sons--विशाल and others. Lord of यक्षस्, and brother of शिव;
1: भा. IX. 2. ३२-33; IV. 1. ३७; ११. ३३. वा. ४०. 8; ४७. 1; ७०. ३८. ९७. 2.
was pleased with Dhruva and blessed him though he killed his followers.
2: भा. IV. १२. 1-9.
Presented a golden throne to पृथु.
3: Ib. १५. १४.
With his नरवाहन attacked कृष्ण taking पारिजात, but defeated by सत्यभामा, retreated in fear. Presented to कृष्ण eight treasures and his new city.
4: Ib. X. [६५ (V) ४५], [६६ (V) 4-२१]; ५०. ५६.
Attended by Guhyakas, he is compared to युधिष्ठिर attended by पाण्डवस्, कृष्ण and sages.
5: Ib. I. 9. 3.
Lord of Alaka and son of Pulastya and resident of Kai- लास;
6: Br. II. १८. 1-2; ३५. ९४; ३६. २१८; M. १२१. 2-3; १३७. ३२; वा. ६९. १९६.
vanquished by रावण; wife ऋद्धि and son Nala- कूबेर.
7: Br. III. 7. २५४ and ३३१; 8. ४४; ७२. 2; IV. १५. २२; वा. ७०. ४१.
Man as his riding animal: followed by यक्षस् and राक्- षसस् with respective standards--उलूक and गृध्र; [page१-394+ ३५] fought with Jambha and Kujambha and was overwhelmed; fled to Indra helpless; beaten by तारक.
8: M. १४८. ८४; १५०. ५०-108; १५३. १७९.
By residing in Benares, attained the status of a गणेश;
9: M. १८०. ६२.
observed the आदित्यशयनवृअतम्;
१०: Ib. ४७. ३०; ५५. ३२.
penance at the conflu- ence of the नर्मदा and the कावेरी and was blessed by शिव to be the Lord of यक्षस्;
११: Ib. १८९. 4-११; १९१. ८५.
icon of;
१२: Ib. २६१. २०-2.
defended the chariot of त्रिपुरारि.
१३: Ib. १३३. ६३; १३८. २५; १४०. ४१.

--a sacred place fit for श्राद्ध; near नन्दा in the N. E. direction; a सिद्धक्षेत्र; a temple of महादेव; the lord performed austerities standing on one leg in the देवी's temple for a युग (दिव्य)। Br. III. १३. ८०; वा. ७७. ७८-81.
--got final release by सत्सङ्ग। भा. XI. १२. 6.
